Decomposition 2026-11-09 (PST), children in dependency order (each depends_on the previous unless noted):
1. polonium-autophobic-anchovy - ADR 0123 (design record).
2. maize-guilty-hapuku - releases in compiled state via new RELEASE_DELTA event, SCHEMA_VERSION 6.
3. lovely-bipartisan-mullet - inbound: Jira fixVersions -> RELEASE_DELTA(source=inbound); FIELD_CONTRACT/FIELD_CLASSES registration.
4. volcanic-prim-parakeet - outbound: per-item fixVersions add/remove on Cloud and DC, intent-gated REMOVE, same-pass suppression.
5. gymnasial-snappy-lorikeet - withhold missing/archived versions, BRIDGE_ALERT lifecycle, never create versions.
6. waiting-nonspinal-ermine - edit/list/show/library/MCP surfaces and docs (depends on outbound, so no local RELEASE_DELTA writer exists before the intent gate).
7. plucky-jetblack-parrot - [non-codebase] production round trip (depends on 5 and 6).

Read-only Jira findings 2026-11-09 (PST), recorded in the ADR Evidence section:
- /rest/api/3/field: fixVersions schema {"type":"array","items":"version","system":"fixVersions"}.
- REB-7015 editmeta: no fixVersions entry (labels: add/set/remove).
- All 144 projects visible to the bridge account have 0 versions; JQL "fixVersion is not EMPTY" returns 0 issues. So per-item add/remove cannot be exercised live anywhere on the site without creating a version; the first live write is child 7.
- Atlassian docs: Fix Versions supports Set/Add/Remove by id or name.
- Contradiction: the Cloud OpenAPI description of PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{key} says it "doesn't check screen configurations", while this epic lists adding Fix versions to REB's edit screen as a prerequisite. Child 7 resolves it live.
- Data Center already fetches fixVersions: the adapter's search passes no fields, and pycontribs JIRA.search_issues maps that to *all. Cloud needs fixVersions added to the search field list (acli.py).

Carrier choice (ADR decides): a new RELEASE_DELTA type, not a TAG_DELTA field selector, because an older clone that knows TAG_DELTA would fold release names into tags.
